Agent: Got it, boiler service. What’s your name?
User: Priya
Agent: Priya, got it. What’s the postcode?
User: NE1 4AL
Agent: Postcode N-E-1-4-A-L, lovely. What’s the house number or property name?
User: 42
Agent: House number 42, perfect. And the street name?
User: Yes, correct
Agent: I’m checking the nearest service slots now.
Agent: Right, I’ve got today between 3 and 7, or tomorrow morning. Which suits?
User: Can't do tomorrow, I'm at work
Agent: Tomorrow doesn’t work, no problem. Which day works this week?
User: Thursday's no good either, I'm busy that day
Agent: Thursday’s no good, understood. Morning or afternoon? Pick one.
User: No, that doesn't work either. I'm really busy this week.
Agent: Busy this week, got it. No problem — we’ll have someone reach out.
User: No sorry, none of those work.
